reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that market fairness must be extracted from raw odds before being used in probabilistic models. The 'honesty trap' lies in conflating heuristic confidence with calibrated model probability. The system enforces a two-stage process: first, expose the devigged fair probability as an immutable field in ScoredPick; second, delay assignment of modelProb until a calibrated model exists. This prevents premature overfitting or misinterpretation of confidence scores. The pick proof receipt ensures each pick's integrity and allows reconstruction of slates post-hoc. The slate commitment uses SHA-256 to fix a set of picks before kickoff, enabling verification of inclusion. These primitives form a closed loop of trust: from market signal to calibrated inference to cryptographic proof.
